title: Database System Concepts
summary:
The text is designed for a first course in databases at the junior/senior 
    undergraduate level or the first year graduate level. It also contains 
    additional material that can be used as supplements or as introductory 
    material for an advanced course. Because the authors present 
    concepts as intuitive descriptions, a familiarity with basic data 
    structures, computer organization, and a high-level programming 
    language are the only prerequisites. Important theoretical results are 
    covered, but formal proofs are omitted. In place of proofs, figures and 
    examples are used to suggest why a result is true.
